text.text: Your inspection business in one place. Run today's Inspections, deliver reports on time, keep Referral partners warm, collect on Invoices, and renew licences and calibrations before they lapse. Operational tracking only.
Agents work against short contingency windows. Fast, clear booking wins repeat referrals.
Create the inspection with the address, client and agent.
Confirm access, utilities and who will attend.
Send the agreement and payment link.
Mark Confirmed once the agreement is signed.
Send the arrival window to the client and the agent.
Deliver it by the agreed time.
Mark Delivered and create the invoice.
Offer a short call to answer questions within three days.
Referrals are the engine of the business. Keep it personal.
Send the agent a thank-you and a link to the report
Open Referral partners and use the Next 30 days view.
Call or message each partner and update Last contact.
Move good partners up from New to Regular to Top referrer.
Open Equipment and licences, Next 30 days view.
Start each renewal with the issuer.
Pause using any overdue equipment until it is calibrated.
